doc: Promise ids a test module may name with pytest.mark.promise. Seeded from the OpenAPM requirement ids (docs/public/specs/manifests/openapm-v0.1.requirements.yml) and the registered architecture owners (.apm/architecture/owners/*.json, prefixed owner:). Add an id here when a new test protects a promise that is not listed yet.
